references.text: God commands the manna to be gathered daily, which reflects the prayer for daily bread
An encouragement to seek the Lord for what truly nourishes, parallel to asking for what is essential for life
Describes the manna as grain from heaven, connecting to the prayer for daily bread
Jesus quotes Scripture that man does not live by bread alone, providing a deeper understanding of 'daily bread'
Jesus offers himself as the spiritual bread, expanding on the concept of asking for 'our daily bread'
